dict.string: This app listens for nearby Bluetooth Low Energy advertisements to flag possible unwanted trackers. It never connects to or pairs with any device.

macOS only reveals the names (SSIDs) of nearby Wi-Fi networks to apps that have Location access. This app uses that permission solely to read Wi-Fi network names for local analysis; your location is never read, stored or sent anywhere.
